strategies.name: Compute / equity divergence
strategies.objective: Trade CRWV when the gap between compute prices and the CRWV and NBIS equity pair stretches.
strategies.rule: spread = 20d change of the H100 on-demand index minus the mean 20d change of CRWV and NBIS; z = spread z-score over the trailing 60 days; buy CRWV when z > +1.5 (the pair lags rising compute prices), sell CRWV when z < -1.5, hold otherwise. Only CRWV is traded; NBIS enters the spread only.

strategies.name: Supply-regime shift
strategies.objective: Detect a level shift in compute prices and position IREN, a power-first operator, accordingly.
strategies.rule: ratio = 20d mean / 60d mean of the H100 on-demand index; buy IREN when ratio > 1.05 (tightening), sell IREN when ratio < 0.95 (prices falling, oversupply regime), hold otherwise.

strategies.name: Infrastructure-event reaction
strategies.objective: React to verified announcements and earnings items for a covered name.
strategies.rule: buy a universe ticker named by a verified announcement or earnings item with severity >= 3 observed in the last 3 days, with one eighth of the remaining cash; sell it 10 calendar days after entry; hold otherwise.
